{{Short description|Iranian physicist}}
'''Iraj Malekpour''' (ایرج ملکپور) is an born [[Amol]] [[Iran]]ian university professor of space physics.

He was famous in [[Iran]] for writing and preparing the annual calendar that was officially used in Iran until 2002.<ref>[https://thethinice.blogspot.com/2003_03_01_archive.html یخ نازک، برتراند الیزابت: 03/01/2003 - 04/01/2003]</ref><ref>[http://www.ghasedakonline.com/article.php?aid=125 Ghasedak, The Online Magazine of Iranian Students at Toronto Universities]  {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110518220338/http://www.ghasedakonline.com/article.php?aid=125 |date=May 18, 2011 }}</ref>

He holds an adjunct faculty position at [[Tehran University]], and works at the Tehran University's [[Institute of Geophysics]].

He holds a PhD from France.

It has been said that he has been purged from the university faculty recently.<ref>[http://ghalamusb.wordpress.com/category/%D8%AA%D8%AD%DA%A9%DB%8C%D9%85-%D9%88%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%AA/ تحکیم وحدت « قلم انجمن]  {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110718095739/http://ghalamusb.wordpress.com/category/%D8%AA%D8%AD%DA%A9%DB%8C%D9%85-%D9%88%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%AA/ |date=July 18, 2011 }}</ref>
